dimensions.name: Problem framing and novelty
dimensions.rationale: The paper turns thickness-only non-identifiability into a bounded mechanism-discrimination question with a geometry-plus-audit baseline and a precise scope boundary.

dimensions.name: Mechanistic and causal rigor
dimensions.rationale: The conditional proposition, four conceptual equations, registration uncertainty, falsifier, alternatives, audit-first rule, and four outcome branches are explicit; the model interface remains intentionally unspecified.

dimensions.name: Evidence traceability
dimensions.rationale: Nine cited component anchors are cross-validated in the upstream Survey and the document separates them from the proposed joint mechanism, but the Survey-to-Idea binding is manual and no design-specific full-text evidence is added.

dimensions.name: Research-design completeness
dimensions.rationale: Comparison accounts, audit requirements, alternatives, registration logic, reproducibility metadata, and outcome branches are present; model-system choice, calibration plan, estimand, and repetition rationale remain human decisions.

dimensions.name: Scholarly communication
dimensions.rationale: The six-page IEEE manuscript separates proposal claims from literature context, uses explicit equations and tables, and preserves non-claims.

dimensions.name: Safety and governance
dimensions.rationale: The scope is non-biological, physical execution is prohibited, and chemical-safety/facility confirmation is an explicit gate.

blocking_items: The manuscript cannot progress to a physical implementation without chemical-safety, facility, calibration, and model-system review.
Manual Survey-to-Idea provenance remains subject to human confirmation.
priority_improvements: Obtain expert approval for a bounded non-biological model interface and a cross-channel comparability definition.
Add design-specific full-text evidence for the selected measurement architecture after the model-system scope is confirmed.
Register the estimand, uncertainty model, and repetition/precision rationale before any future study is contemplated.
Add design-specific literature and registered analysis choices only after the model-system scope is approved by qualified experts.

compiled_artifact.visual_audit: All six rendered pages checked: no clipping, overlap, missing text, or overfull box. Eight natural Underfull spacing warnings are recorded as approved build-manifest exceptions.

known_nonclaims: No observed interfacial mechanism, stability transition, or transport effect is reported.
No universal claim across materials, liquids, solids, or applications is made.
No material identity, chemical formulation, physical procedure, or instrument configuration is supplied.
